鬧彆扭.m: to be difficult with sb; to provoke disagreement; at loggerheads

鬧心.m: to be vexed or annoyed; to feel queasy

鬧情緒.m: to be in a bad mood

鬧房.m: see 鬧洞房|闹洞房[nao4 dong4 fang2]

鬧新房.m: see 鬧洞房|闹洞房[nao4 dong4 fang2]

鬧洞房.m: disturbing the privacy of bridal room (Chinese custom where guests banter with and play pranks on the newlyweds)

鬧矛盾.m: to be at loggerheads; to have a falling out

鬧笑話.m: to make a fool of oneself

鬧翻.m: to have a falling out; to have a big argument

鬧著玩兒.m: to play games; to joke around; to play a joke on sb

鬧鈴.m: alarm bell (on a clock or phone)

鬧騰.m: to disturb; to create confusion; to make a din
